cover_prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: landscape software cover artwork, also used as a desktop launch splash and GitHub README cover.
Primary request: design an elegant, precise, professional cover for the existing astronomy application OccultationVisualiser, which synchronizes asteroid-occultation light curves and recorded star-field frames.
Scene/backdrop: deep dark navy astronomical field with a few restrained small stars, consistent with the application's dark scientific plots.
Subject: a single irregular charcoal asteroid silhouette passing in front of one bright white stellar point, partial disappearance at the edge. Pair the astronomical motif with a clean luminous blue light-curve line showing a brief flat-bottom flux dip and recovery. This is a conceptual brand illustration, not observed event data.
Style: sophisticated restrained astronomy editorial illustration, crisp minimal shapes, subtle lighting, high contrast, ample breathing room. Avoid busy sci-fi effects.
Composition: wide landscape 16:9 cover, all key content safely inside margins. The astronomical motif and a single small light-curve motif complement the typography; visual hierarchy should read immediately at small size.
Text verbatim: "OccultationVisualiser". One line, large, very legible refined sans-serif type. This is the only text. Preserve the spelling exactly: O c c u l t a t i o n V i s u a l i s e r.
Constraints: no extra logos, no invented slogan, no planets with rings, no telescope equipment, no axes or fabricated measurement labels, no watermarks, no UI screenshot or device mockup, no collage. Render as finished flat cover artwork.
icon_prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: square desktop application icon for OccultationVisualiser, derived from the accompanying software-cover style.
Input image 1: stylistic reference only; this is a new icon, not an edit to the cover.
Primary request: create a polished, legible astronomy app icon matching the deep navy, blue light-curve and charcoal asteroid/white star motif of the reference cover.
Composition: one rounded-square dark navy tile centered on a genuinely transparent outer background. Inside, a bold simplified irregular asteroid silhouette partly hides a compact brilliant white star with a small restrained glint. Under it a thick electric-blue light-curve line has a single flat-bottom dip and recovery. Keep this single motif large and readable as a 32-pixel icon; fewer details than the cover. Generous even margins within the tile, clean crisp edges.
Style: premium restrained scientific desktop-app icon, simplified dimensional illustration, subtle edge light, strong silhouette. No visual clutter.
Constraints: exactly square, transparent outside rounded tile, no letters or text, no axes, no extra logos, no watermark, no device mockup, no rings or solar corona. Finished icon artwork, not an icon sheet.
